candidate_measure: Distance from each 100 m grid cell to selected road classes
notes: Road hierarchy/class filtering must be inspected before distance criterion is created.

candidate_measure: Road length/density around each 100 m grid cell
notes: Neighbourhood radius and road classes must be defined before calculation.

candidate_measure: Building footprint/density surrounding each 100 m grid cell
notes: Used only for current development context, not as historical pressure evidence.

candidate_measure: Mean or representative slope within each 100 m grid cell
notes: Lower slopes are generally more physically suitable, but final standardization thresholds require justification.

candidate_measure: Mean elevation within each 100 m grid cell
notes: Do not assume higher or lower elevation is automatically more suitable without planning/environmental justification.

candidate_measure: Reference land-cover class or land-cover proportion
notes: WorldCover 2021 is an independent reference, not current 2026 ground truth.
